known_limitations: MACD uses close EMA12 minus EMA26, adjust=False recursion seeded from the first observed close; EMA26 becomes mature after26 closes. Signal uses9 mature MACD values. The first previous/current pair is index34. Only immediate configured-duration neighbors can cross; equality at current signal waits.

BUY requires previous MACD<=previous signal and current MACD>current signal; SELL mirrors this. These are closed-bar directional confirmations, not an unbounded order generator. No caller indicator columns or future candles are trusted.

EMA seeding, maturity, M5 application, trend_up/London/normal context and hour horizon are explicit laboratory conventions. The cited source gives indicator defaults/crossing interpretation, not economic qualification of this composition.
Only an existing strategy candidate can be vetoed. Physical strategy, risk, costs and exit stay identical. Missing history cannot confirm.
